name: eng-2194
title: Node summoning menu "Only" button stretches across filter row

prepare.why: the extension has a local database session for this graph, since the local create-space edge function is down
an empty page to type the node search trigger on

cases.title: Each Only button sizes to its label at the right edge of its row
cases.caption: In the node summoning menu's type filter, the Only button now fits its label and sits at the right edge of each row, instead of taking half the row.

steps.why: hover Claim so its Only button shows

expect.js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48 .bp3-menu-item')).filter(proof.visible); proof.assert(rows.length >= 4, 'Expected at least 4 type rows, found ' + rows.length + '.'); for (const row of rows) { const only = proof.byText('button', 'Only', row); proof.assert(only, 'A type row has no Only button.'); const box = proof.rect(only); const style = getComputedStyle(row); const contentRight = proof.rect(row).right - parseFloat(style.paddingRight) - parseFloat(style.borderRightWidth); const edge = contentRight - box.right; proof.assert(box.width < 100, 'The Only button is ' + Math.round(box.width) + 'px wide; it should fit its label.'); proof.assert(Math.abs(edge) <= 2, 'The Only button sits ' + Math.round(edge) + 'px inside the row content edge.'); } })()

cases.title: Only on Claim leaves just the Claim results
cases.caption: Clicking Only still does its job: the filter closes and only the Claim results are left.

expect.js: proof.waitFor(() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .h-64 > div > .border-b')).filter(proof.visible).map((el) => el.innerText.trim()); return headers.length === 1 && headers[0] === 'Claim' && !document.querySelector('.discourse-node-search-menu .max-h-48'); }, { what: 'only the Claim results, with the filter closed' })
